implementation: Same-process cancellation subscriptions and native filesystem notifications over an owner-only notification directory; every wake rechecks actual queue, lease token, owner and capacity. Periodic 500ms reconciliation retained.

qualification.host: Ryzen 9 7950X3D, 16 cores/32 logical processors, Balanced power plan
qualification.runs: Sequential platform runs; no local build was running during measurement
qualification.criterion: held-lease release to cross-process grant p95 below 20 ms

limitations: Development build measurement, not final release certification
Free-capacity fast-path comparison and wider benchmark uncertainty remain under H03/H11
Native macOS implementation requires hosted qualification
Notifications carry no grant authority; protected filesystem access authenticates the channel boundary
Durable indexed lease projection/integration remains outstanding

resource_vectors.policy: Declared reservations, charged once per weighted lease across execution and watch pools. Zero disables that aggregate dimension; these are not measurements of OS usage. Existing process sandbox limits remain separate.
adapters: configured local-provider GPU reservation requiring explicit global GPU capacity
research runner memory and disk reservation
resource_vectors.tests: Memory/GPU/disk contention, shared pool accounting, weighted single charge, release and impossible-request refusal passed on Windows and Linux. Backend run + actual isolated effect + Tasks SDK passed on both platforms.
